mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies around Fireman's Park with a temperature of 73 degrees.

The city is keeping up with engineering reports provided to the council by AECOM. Additionally, WisDOT is hosting public sessions regarding the US 18/151 Corridor Study, offering both an in-person meeting in Mount Horeb on November 18 and a virtual option on November 19 to discuss new design concepts.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can catch Live Music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, or Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, ART House 360 begins their Thursday night series tomorrow, followed by Trick-Or-Treating at Hometown Junction Park on October 30.

In our weekly police update, on October 23, two juveniles were contacted for riding prohibited eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations issued to their parents for permitting a minor to operate a motor vehicle.
Culver's is serving up their delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch today. The restaurant is currently open, so feel free to stop by anytime before they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
